recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. If substanceExposureRisk semantics change in the future, make that work in the FHIR Extension Pack; no FHIR-core follow-up is needed for FHIR-11025.
issue_request: FHIR-11025 was a Published FHIR-core AllergyIntolerance change request resolved Not Persuasive with Modification. It asked for clear differentiation between assertions of the presence and absence of adverse-reaction risk, and the accepted action was to add a usage note that substanceExposureRisk.exposureRisk is a modifier of the substance.

The same commit also corrected the No Known Allergy SNOMED example code referenced by the Jira resolution.
additional_context: AllergyIntolerance remains an active core resource and current core guidance still explains no-known-allergy coding plus the substanceExposureRisk alternative. Core no longer owns the extension definition after dd468d4f1799dd79819315b211588ef1cf4586e0 removed AllergyIntolerance extension definitions from R5 source. The FHIR Extension Pack now contains StructureDefinition-allergyintolerance-substanceExposureRisk.xml with the exposureRisk comment required by FHIR-11025, and later FHIR-42977 refined the same extension text and invariant in that external repository.
